# KAVITY

> KAVITY — exclusive agent in Jordan for UNITECH – IKK Group. Façade fixation, cable management, expansion joints, ceiling grid, chutes and raised flooring, supplied from Amman with in-house structural calculation and shop drawings.

KAVITY (KAVITY for Construction Solutions & Materials; in Arabic كافيتي) is an engineering and supply company for specialised building systems in Amman, Jordan: Wasfi Al-Tal St. (Gardens St.), Noura Complex, Amman. It is the exclusive agent in Jordan for UNITECH – IKK Group. Project teams send drawings, the specification and the load requirements; KAVITY's engineers size the system and prepare a technical proposal with the calculation and shop drawings needed for approval.

- Website (English): https://www.kavityengineering.com/
- Arabic overview: https://www.kavityengineering.com/ar/
- E-mail: info.jordan@kabrillc.com
- Phone: +962 6 551 5905 · WhatsApp: +962 79 777 4295
- Product data: each product card on the range pages names its source catalogue and page; the catalogues are a direct PDF download on the Catalogues page. Company details (agency, contacts) are as stated on this website.

## Façade fixation

- [Mechanical cladding fixation](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/mechanical-cladding-fixation.html): Stainless steel bracket systems that fix stone and ceramic cladding mechanically, panel by panel, to the building structure.
- [L-brackets — Mechanical cladding fixation](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/l-brackets.html): The primary load-bearing bracket. Anchored to the concrete or blockwork backing wall, it carries the dead load of the cladding panel.
- [Z-brackets — Mechanical cladding fixation](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/z-brackets.html): Used where the cavity is deeper than an L-bracket suits — the offset leg sets the panel line further out from the anchor. Common on insulated façades.
- [Omega brackets — Mechanical cladding fixation](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/omega-bracket.html): Designed for panels fixed beneath a concrete slab — soffits and returns. Adjustable in two directions, ±5 mm and ±10 mm.
- [Fishtail brackets — Mechanical cladding fixation](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/fishtail-bracket.html): Fishtail anchors embedded in reinforced concrete or solid blockwork walls, with a pin or up-and-down tabs that support and restrain the stone panels.
- [Corrugated dowels & studs — Mechanical cladding fixation](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/corrugated-dowel.html): Mortar anchors with a corrugated stud, set in cement mortar in the backing wall — used for the last row of panels, in horizontal or vertical joints, for wind loads up to 1 kN.
- [Anchors & fixings — Mechanical cladding fixation](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/anchors.html): Chemical and mechanical anchors sized to the substrate — concrete, hollow block or brickwork — and to the pull-out load of the bracket.
- [Steel back support systems — Mechanical cladding fixation](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/steel-back-support.html): Where the structure cannot take the fixing directly, a secondary steel frame carries the cladding back to the slab.

## MEP & cable management

- [Cable trays & accessories](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/cable-trays.html): Perforated and solid cable trays with the full run of bends, tees, reducers and covers, manufactured to IEC 61537.
- [Cable tray runs — Cable trays & accessories](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/cable-tray-runs.html): Straight lengths in light, medium, heavy and very heavy duty — perforated or solid bottom, in four thicknesses.
- [Cable tray fittings — Cable trays & accessories](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/cable-tray-fittings.html): Horizontal and vertical bends, tees, crosses and reducers — factory formed so the bend radius protects the cable.
- [Cable tray accessories — Cable trays & accessories](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/cable-tray-accessories.html): Covers, couplers, earth continuity straps and end caps that complete the installation.
- [Cable tray support systems — Cable trays & accessories](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/cable-tray-supports.html): Cantilever arms, trapeze hangers, wall brackets and channel — the support spacing follows the published load table.
- [Cable ladders](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/cable-ladders.html): Welded and swaged ladder systems for heavy cable runs and long unsupported spans.
- [Welded cable ladders — Cable ladders](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/welded-ladders.html): Rungs welded to the side rail for maximum mechanical strength — the choice for the heaviest loads and longest spans.
- [Swaged cable ladders — Cable ladders](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/swaged-ladders.html): Tubular rungs cold-swaged into the side rails without welding heat — in aluminium or steel.
- [Fittings & supports — Cable ladders](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/ladder-fittings-supports.html): Bends, tees, risers, couplers, cantilever arms and trapeze framing sized to the ladder profile.
- [Firestop systems — Cable ladders](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/ladder-firestop.html): Firestop sealants, pathways, putty, pillows, mortar and cable coatings from STI Firestop for cable penetrations through fire-rated walls and floors.
- [Basket trays](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/basket-trays.html): Wire basket trays for data, control and lighter power cabling — cut and formed on site without special tooling.
- [Runs & fittings — Basket trays](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/basket-runs-fittings.html): Welded 4 mm steel-wire mesh lengths in four side heights. Bends and tees are cut and formed on site — no factory fitting needed.
- [Accessories, supports & framing — Basket trays](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/basket-supports.html): Couplers, wall brackets, trapeze framing, drop-outs and the fixing hardware that turns cut mesh into a finished run.
- [Cable trunking](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/cable-trunkings.html): Single, double and triple compartment trunking for segregated circuits, with quick-locking lids and matched fittings.
- [Trunking runs & fittings — Cable trunking](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/trunking-runs-fittings.html): Straight lengths in single, double and triple compartment, with matched bends, tees and reducers.
- [Trunking accessories — Cable trunking](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/trunking-accessories.html): Connectors, earth links, bonding jumpers, suspension brackets and stirrup hangers that complete a trunking run.
- [FRP cable management](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/frp-cable-management.html): Fibreglass-reinforced plastic (FRP) trays, ladders, grating and handrail for corrosive, harsh and marine environments.
- [FRP trays & ladders — FRP cable management](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/frp-trays-ladders.html): Pultruded fibreglass trays and ladders for corrosive environments — lightweight, non-conductive and non-magnetic.
- [FRP & steel support systems — FRP cable management](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/frp-support-systems.html): FRP and steel strut channel, cantilever arms, U- and I-supports, plates and clamps for carrying FRP cable trays and ladders.
- [FRP grating & handrail — FRP cable management](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/frp-grating-handrail.html): Moulded and pultruded grating, grating clips and handrail for walkways over process plant and water treatment.
- [C-channel strut systems](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/c-channel-strut.html): Slotted and plain strut channel with channel nuts, brackets and fittings — MEP support frames built without welding.
- [Channels — C-channel strut systems](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/channels.html): Plain and slotted strut channel in 41 and 50 mm series, in standard thicknesses of 1.5, 2.0 and 2.5 mm, in single and back-to-back sections.
- [Toothed channels — C-channel strut systems](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/toothed-channels.html): Serrated lips give the channel nut a positive lock, for connections that must carry a higher load along the channel.
- [Fittings — C-channel strut systems](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/channel-fittings.html): Flat plates, angle brackets, gussets, base plates and beam clamps that turn channel into a frame.
- [Accessories & anchors — C-channel strut systems](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/channel-accessories.html): Channel nuts, hammer-head bolts, threaded rod and couplers, washers, beam clamps and mechanical anchors for concrete and masonry.
- [Pipe clamps & hangers](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/pipe-clamps.html): Rubber-lined and plain clamps, hangers, threaded rods and anchors for pipework from ½ in to 6 in (offset clamps to 8 in).
- [Clamps & hangers — Pipe clamps & hangers](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/clamps-hangers.html): Rubber-lined and plain clamps from ½ in (DN15) service pipe to 6 in pipework, each with a rated load capacity.
- [Support systems — Pipe clamps & hangers](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/pipe-support-system.html): Plain, slotted, back-to-back and toothed C-channel with cantilever arm brackets — the framing that pipe clamps and hangers are fixed to.
- [Threaded accessories — Pipe clamps & hangers](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/threaded-accessories.html): Threaded rod, anchor bolts, couplers, hexagon nuts and washers in matched sizes and finishes.

## Architectural & finishing

- [Architectural expansion joints](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/architectural-expansion-joints.html): Floor, wall, ceiling and roof joint covers that absorb movement while keeping the finish continuous.
- [Floor expansion joints — Architectural expansion joints](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/floor-joints.html): Trafficked covers for floor gaps — sized to the movement range and to whether the load is pedestrian, private cars or vehicles.
- [Wall & ceiling joints — Architectural expansion joints](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/wall-ceiling-joints.html): Surface and recessed profiles that keep a clean line across a moving joint on wall and soffit.
- [Roof & parking joints — Architectural expansion joints](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/roof-parking-joints.html): Watertight joints for exposed decks and parking structures, with rubber seals or a waterproof membrane system.
- [Fire-rated & seismic joints — Architectural expansion joints](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/fire-rated-joints.html): Seismic profiles that accept multi-directional movement, and the NFB fire barrier beneath the cover (2 hours to UL 2079; classification in progress).
- [Tile movement joints — Architectural expansion joints](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/tile-movement-joints.html): Profiles set into the tile bed that let a large tiled field expand without lifting or cracking at the grout line.
- [Entrance matting, profiles & wall protection](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/entrance-matting-wall-protection.html): Entrance mats, stair nosings, tile edge profiles, handrails and impact protection for the parts of a building that take the traffic.
- [Entrance matting systems — Entrance matting, profiles & wall protection](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/entrance-matting.html): Aluminium entrance mats with carpet, brush or rubber inserts that take dirt and moisture off shoes and wheels at the door.
- [Stair nosing — Entrance matting, profiles & wall protection](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/stair-nosing.html): Slip-resistant profiles fixed to the nose of each step to mark the edge and protect it from wear.
- [Wall & tile profiles — Entrance matting, profiles & wall protection](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/wall-profiles.html): Right-angle and round profiles that protect wall corners and finish the edges of tile and stone.
- [Handrails & wall protection — Entrance matting, profiles & wall protection](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/handrails-wall-protection.html): Handrails, wall guards, corner guards and door protection for corridors that carry trolleys, beds and carts.
- [Heavy impact protection — Entrance matting, profiles & wall protection](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/heavy-impact-protection.html): Rubber and polymer guards that protect columns, walls and docks in car parks, warehouses and loading areas.
- [Metal ceiling grid systems](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/metal-ceiling-grid.html): C-channel ceiling grids hung from the soffit on threaded rods and omega brackets — Standard, Advanced, Extreme and back-to-back series, sized to the ceiling and services they carry.
- [Exposed grid — Metal ceiling grid systems](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/exposed-grid.html): The standard tee-bar system — main runners and cross tees visible below the tile, giving full access to the void.
- [Semi-concealed & clip-in grid — Metal ceiling grid systems](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/concealed-grid.html): Systems where the grid is partly or fully hidden behind the tile edge — tiles are clipped or hooked in.
- [Section details & connectors — Metal ceiling grid systems](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/grid-sections.html): C-channel sections, couplers, omega brackets, threaded rods and L or T bracket connectors that assemble and hang the grid.
- [C-channel ceiling grid systems — Metal ceiling grid systems](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/c-channel-ceiling-grid.html): Galvanised C-channel grids hung on threaded rods and omega brackets to carry services and ceilings — Standard, Advanced, Extreme and back-to-back series.
- [Garbage & linen chutes](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/garbage-linen-chutes.html): Complete waste and linen chute systems for hotels, hospitals and residential towers.
- [Chute components — Garbage & linen chutes](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/chute-components.html): Chute sections, intake doors, discharge units, offsets and the shaft brackets that fix the run to the structure.
- [Chute sorters & diverters — Garbage & linen chutes](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/chute-sorters.html): A diverter at the base sends waste to the correct bin by stream — the mechanism that makes in-building recycling work.
- [Sanitising & compaction — Garbage & linen chutes](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/chute-sanitising.html): Wash-down and disinfection units at the head of the shaft, and the compactor or containers at the base.
- [Raised access flooring](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/raised-access-flooring.html): Adjustable pedestals and elevated floor systems for terraces, plant rooms and data floors.
- [Outdoor pedestals — Raised access flooring](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/outdoor-pedestals.html): Adjustable pedestals for terraces and roof decks — the slab below can fall to drain while the finish above stays level.
- [Indoor access floors — Raised access flooring](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/indoor-access-floor.html): Porcelain slabs on self-levelling adjustable pedestals for plant rooms, technical rooms and interiors, with a service void for cabling and pipework.
- [Timber decking supports — Raised access flooring](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/decking-supports.html): Joist-carrying heads that take timber and composite decking on the same adjustable pedestal base.

## Civil solutions

- [Plaster beads & expanded metal](https://www.kavityengineering.com/product/plaster-beads-expanded-metal.html): Angle, stop, control joint and architrave beads with expanded mesh wings that lock into render.
- [Plaster beads — Plaster beads & expanded metal](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/plaster-beads.html): Angle, stop, control joint, architrave and movement beads — the range that gives plaster and render straight, reinforced edges and controls cracking.
- [Expanded metal & lath — Plaster beads & expanded metal](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/expanded-metal-lath.html): Rib lath, coil lath and corner mesh that key the render across dissimilar substrates and over service chases.
- [Steel lintels — Plaster beads & expanded metal](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/steel-lintels.html): Pressed steel lintels that carry blockwork over an opening without a cast concrete beam.
- [Blockwork accessories — Plaster beads & expanded metal](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/block-accessories.html): Wall ties, frame cramps, head restraints and debonding ties that tie blockwork across the cavity and back to the structure.
- [Blockwork reinforcement — Plaster beads & expanded metal](https://www.kavityengineering.com/s/block-reinforcement.html): Ladder and truss reinforcement laid in the bed joint to distribute shrinkage stress along the wall.
